summary: Model card for Gemini 3.7 Flash. Reports price and a broad set of capability benchmarks (coding, agents, documents, biology research), automated safety deltas vs Gemini 3.6 Flash in percentage points, a red-teaming summary, and its own FSF (April-2026) results table with tracked and critical capability levels, finding none reached but alert thresholds reached for CBRN and cyber.

framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework
framework.level_or_determination: No TCL/CCL reached; alert thresholds reached for CBRN Uplift Level 1 and Cyber Uplift Level 1
framework.quote: We evaluated Gemini 3.7 Flash as outlined in our latest Frontier Safety Framework (April-2026), and found that it did not reach any tracked or critical capability levels as outlined in the table below:

evals: Expert red teaming vs web baselines
cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Uplift TCL and Uplift Level 1 CCL ruled out with reasonable confidence; expert red teaming showed modest uplift and some experts elicited actionable info across full harm journey, so alert threshold reached.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: prompting us to assess that the model has reached the alert threshold for this CCL.

cyber.finding: Reaches cyber alert threshold but not CCL; mitigations deployed.
cyber.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches the alert threshold for this CCL, but not the CCL.

autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: Can complete individual coding tasks but not chain them into end-to-end research workflow; below alert threshold for Acceleration/Automation Level 1.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: lacks the independence to chain them into an end-to-end research workflow without human intervention.

metrics.name: Text to Text Safety vs Gemini 3.6 Flash
Image to Text Safety vs Gemini 3.6 Flash

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Automated content-safety results reported only as relative deltas vs Gemini 3.6 Flash; manual review said losses were false positives or not egregious.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Overall, Gemini 3.7 Flash performs similarly to Gemini 3.6 Flash across both safety and tone, with low unjustified refusals.

over_refusal.finding: Single relative delta on borderline prompts.
over_refusal.quote: Automated evaluation measuring model's ability to respond to borderline prompts while remaining safe

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Jailbreak resistance named as ongoing work.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: we are continually working to improve jailbreak resistance and have recently strengthened the mitigations across Frontier Safety.

deception_scheming.finding: Stronger situational awareness than 3.1 Pro; recognizes testing environments but cannot bypass restrictions; Stealth and Situational Awareness TCL not reached.
deception_scheming.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash is observant enough to correctly assess when it is in a testing environment, but it cannot successfully bypass testing restrictions.

evals: Human red teaming child safety launch thresholds
child_safety.finding: Satisfied child-safety launch thresholds; no numbers.
child_safety.quote: For child safety evaluations, Gemini 3.7 Flash satisfied required launch thresholds

evals: Human behavioural studies on harmful manipulation
election_misinfo.finding: Some ability to influence beliefs/behaviours but efficacy beneath alert threshold.
election_misinfo.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash demonstrates some ability to influence user beliefs and behaviors during one-on-one direct conversations in human behavioural studies.

multilingual_safety.quote: Automated safety policy evaluation across multiple languages

system_safeguards.finding: Ships with updated CBRN and cyber misuse safeguards.
system_safeguards.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash is shipping with updated safeguards to prevent misuse in the domains of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) and cyber offense.

notable_new_eval_methods: First Flash model card with its own FSF results table; introduces Tracked Capability Levels (TCLs) under FSF April-2026 (p.8)
Combined 'ML R&D and Misalignment' domain with Stealth and Situational Awareness TCL (p.9)

self_reported_limitations.text: Testing environments may under-elicit capabilities and threat actors could scale misuse absent mitigations.
Safety results computed with improved evaluations, not directly comparable with previous model cards.
Model can recognize testing environments (evaluation awareness).

notes: Points to separate Gemini 3.7 FSF report. Text to Text Safety regressed +1.17pp.
